svg.aria-label: Logical clocks: Lamport and vector: A counter that respects causality, and a vector that also refuses to invent an order.. local event: clock + 1; the message carries the clock; Lamport: clock := max(mine, yours) + 1; vector: entrywise max, then my own + 1. Lamport orders what is causally related and invents an order for the rest; a vector leaves the concurrent pairs unordered.
